text:
maria: Heads-up — links to /guides/streaming#response-format are resolving to the admonition header instead of the section. Spotted from a user report: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/streaming#response-format kevin: ugh, sounds like an anchor collision. any chance there's raw HTML around that heading? mkdocs/docusaurus slugify can choke on that. can you paste the markdown snippet? maria: Repro snippet below (from the page): ```md > Note: streaming responses come as newline-delimited JSON
### Response format Some details here with code samples and inline <br/>.
### Examples More content... ``` kevin: yep — the inline HTML wrapper around the admonition produces a duplicate/odd id for the heading. slugifier generates something like `response-format-2` while the anchor link resolves to `response-format`. linkcheck sees one id but the browser lands at the wrapper. sam: quick fixes: 1) remove raw
and use mkdocs/admonition syntax (`!!! warning "Note"`) or 2) give the heading an explicit id: `### Response format {#response-format}`. both are safe. jia: i'll open a tiny PR that swaps the HTML admonition -> mkdocs admonition and adds the explicit id as a belt-and-suspenders measure. pinging @maria for review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 maria: thanks — can we run linkcheck on CI for that branch? want to avoid a new regressing anchor elsewhere. jia: yes. added linkcheck job to the PR: `yarn docs:linkcheck` + `mkdocs build --strict`. also trimmed the inline tags inside code blocks to avoid slug noise. snippet of the patch: ```diff -
-### Response format -Some details here with code samples and inline <br/>. -
+!!! warning "Note" + +### Response format {#response-format} +Some details here with code samples and inline `
` inside fenced blocks. ``` kevin: nice. can we also add a short test to linkcheck config to fail on duplicate slugs? we keep hitting these after partial migrations. sam: i can add a small grep step in the linkcheck job to `sort | uniq -d` on the list of generated slugs — will flag duplicates. cheap and effective. docs-bot: PR #3421 requested reviewers: @maria, @kevin. CI: linkcheck running. deploy-bot: CI passed for docs/pr/3421 — all link checks green. jia: merged to main. commit: 8f4c2a7 — admonition -> mkdocs admonition, explicit id, linkcheck tweak. maria: :tada: thanks everyone. leaving a follow-up task to run a repo-wide scan for other raw HTML admonitions and headings without explicit ids. putting it in the docs backlog. kevin: fyi, i'll add a short note to the migration guide: "Avoid raw HTML wrappers around headings/admonitions — prefer native admonitions or explicit heading ids". keeps future contributors from tripping. maria: perfect. closing the loop. if anyone sees odd anchors, drop them here or open a quick PR. :thumbsup:
